title: Dell KB216-BK-US Wired Black QWERTY Keyboard - Used
descriptionText:
This Dell KB216-BK-US wired black keyboard is a great addition to your computer setup. The keyboard features a QWERTY layout with enhanced function keys and multimedia integration for a seamless experience. The quiet keys ensure that you can type quickly and efficiently without any distractions. 

Made of durable plastic, this slim keyboard is easy to carry around and has a length of 14 inches, a width of 8 inches, and a height of 2 inches. The keyboard connects to your computer via USB and is compatible with all types of computers. This keyboard is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a high-quality, reliable keyboard.
